about_short_description.short_description: Qatar Insurance Company is a firm that offers a diverse portfolio of personal and business lines of insurance products.

product.name: Personal Insurance
product.description: Insurance products for individuals and households, covering vehicles, travel, homes, boats, life, medical needs and mandatory visitor coverage.

product.name: Business Insurance
product.description: Commercial insurance solutions for organizations, including property, marine and aviation, energy, and motor fleet risk coverage.

product.name: Property & Commercial Insurance
product.description: Commercial coverage for business property and related risks, serving retail traders, property developers, banking institutions and other organizations.

product.name: Marine & Aviation Insurance
product.description: Insurance for marine cargo, shipping and aviation risks, including damage, collision, natural hazards, pollution liability and related exposures.

product.name: Energy Insurance
product.description: Insurance solutions for hydrocarbon and energy-sector risks serving Qatar’s government and private-sector organizations.

product.name: Motor Fleet Insurance
product.description: Fleet automobile insurance for organizations seeking protection for multiple vehicles, drivers and related vehicle risks.
